name: MaterialPropertyBlockHelper
src_typeComment: Wraps MaterialPropertyBlock so you can tweak a renderer's color/float/texture properties at runtime without instancing a new Material (which leaks memory if not manually cleaned up, and breaks batching). Drop on any Renderer and call SetColor/SetFloat/SetTexture — the block is applied automatically.
